name: Nonprofit Manager – Donations, Membership, Newsletters & Events
author: Eric Rosenberg

sections.description:
Nonprofit Manager is the free, all-in-one WordPress plugin for small nonprofits, clubs, and community groups. You get membership management, online donations, email newsletters, and an event calendar in one place, so you don’t have to bolt four separate plugins together to run your organization.

Most tools do one job. Donation plugins only take donations. Membership plugins only track members. You keep your members and donors in one system, next to your newsletters and your events. You spend less time wrangling software and more time on your mission. Learn more at nonprofitmanager.app.

Features

Everything without an asterisk is free. Features marked with an asterisk (*) come with Nonprofit Manager Pro when you’re ready for more.

Members and donors

  • Track members with membership levels, filtering, and bulk actions
  • Members and donors share one contact list, so you can see anyone’s lifetime giving at a glance
  • Add signup and unsubscribe forms to any page as blocks or shortcodes, protected by Cloudflare Turnstile
  • Google reCAPTCHA v3 on your forms*
  • Import your existing list from CSV, XLSX, Google Sheets, Mailchimp, or Constant Contact
  • Give a volunteer a Membership Manager login that sees members, donations, and newsletters, and none of your settings
  • Custom member fields with 8 field types and drag-and-drop ordering*
  • Segment members with an AND/OR condition builder*
  • Put members in one or more groups, each with its own newsletters, events, calendar, and signup form*

Donations

  • Accept one-time donations through PayPal, Venmo, and Stripe. Stripe gifts land in your Donations list, and PayPal and Venmo gifts show up in those accounts
  • Drop a donation form on any page as a block or shortcode, with a thank-you message on the page
  • Take gifts in US, Canadian, Australian, or New Zealand dollars, pounds, euros, yen, and 9 more currencies (Venmo is US dollars only)
  • Recurring donations*
  • Membership dues auto-billing*
  • Donor thank-you emails with the gift amount and date*
  • PayPal gifts recorded in your Donations list through PayPal Smart Buttons, with a server-side check of every capture*

Newsletters and email

  • Write newsletters in the editor you already know (Gutenberg), with reusable templates, headers, and footers
  • See who opens and clicks, tracked in dedicated tables that won’t bloat your database
  • Send yourself a test first, let rate limiting pace large sends, and stay CAN-SPAM compliant
  • One-click unsubscribe with RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers, which Gmail and Yahoo now expect
  • Tell subscribers about new posts and events instantly or in an automatic weekly digest, and let them pick their own preferences
  • Schedule one email for each event, such as a reminder the day before, and send any newsletter later from the Scheduled Emails screen
  • List past newsletters on any page with the Newsletters block or [npmp_newsletters]. You pick which ones go public
  • Past newsletters for one group on that group’s page, with [npmp_newsletters group="computing"]*
  • As many scheduled emails as you want for the whole organization, each group, and each event*
  • Email automation workflows: welcome emails, donation receipts, and expiry reminders*
  • Send through Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark, Brevo, or any SMTP server*

Events

  • Event calendar with Month, Week, and List views, plus Calendar and Events blocks for any page, with list, grid, cards, and mosaic layouts
  • iCal feed, quick-add from the dashboard, and one-click convert of any post or page into an event
  • A Print or save as PDF button on calendars and event lists, with a setting to turn it off
  • Move your events over from The Events Calendar, review each one, and keep redirects from the old event URLs
  • Print or save as PDF any admin list or report*

Sharing and outreach

  • Auto-share new posts and events to Facebook and X, with {title}, {url}, and {excerpt} placeholders
  • Auto-share to Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, and Nextdoor*
  • Add share buttons and a contact form to any page, as blocks or shortcodes

External Services

Nonprofit Manager talks to outside services only where a feature needs it. Nothing below runs unless you turn that feature on or enter your own credentials.

Product update emails (optional, off by default)

If you tick the product update box in the setup wizard, your email address and display name are sent once to our newsletter system at news.nonprofitmanager.app to start a double opt-in signup. You then get one confirmation email, and nothing else is sent unless you click it. Leave the box unticked and no request is made. Data sent: your email address and display name, at that one moment. Service: Listmonk, self-hosted by Rosenberg Digital LLC. Privacy policy: https://nonprofitmanager.app/privacy-policy/

Nonprofit Manager Pro licensing (only with Pro installed)

The free plugin on its own does not contact our servers. If you also install Nonprofit Manager Pro, Pro checks your license and looks for updates at nonprofitmanager.app, sending your license key, your site URL, and the installed version. Terms: https://nonprofitmanager.app/terms-of-service/ Privacy policy: https://nonprofitmanager.app/privacy-policy/

Payment processors (only when you enable one)

Donations are sent to the processor you configure with your own account credentials. Stripe (api.stripe.com), PayPal (paypal.com), and Venmo (venmo.com) receive donation amounts and the donor details you collect. Stripe: https://stripe.com/legal and https://stripe.com/privacy PayPal and Venmo: https://www.paypal.com/legalhub/useragreement-full and https://www.paypal.com/privacy

Spam protection (only when you enable one)

If you turn on a captcha, form submissions are verified with Cloudflare Turnstile (challenges.cloudflare.com) or Google reCAPTCHA (google.com/recaptcha), using your own site keys. Cloudflare: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ and https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/ Google: https://policies.google.com/terms and https://policies.google.com/privacy

List imports (only when you run one)

Importing from Mailchimp or Constant Contact reads your list using the API key you supply. Mailchimp: https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/ and https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/ Constant Contact: https://www.constantcontact.com/legal/terms and https://www.constantcontact.com/legal/privacy-notice

Social sharing (only when you connect an account)

Auto-sharing posts sends the title, link, and excerpt you configure to the networks you connect, using your own account credentials.
sections.installation:
1. Install from the WordPress Plugin Directory (search for “Nonprofit Manager”), or upload the nonprofit-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Walk through the setup wizard and turn on only the features you need.
  4. Add your payment details, email settings, and membership levels, and you’re ready to welcome supporters.
sections.faq:
Is Nonprofit Manager free?

Yes. You get membership management, donations, newsletters, scheduled emails, and events in the free plugin, with no trial period. With Nonprofit Manager Pro, you also get groups, recurring donations, email automation, and unlimited imports. You’ll see the Pro controls greyed out in the free plugin, each with one line about what it does.

Which payment services can I use?

PayPal, Venmo, and Stripe for one-time donations, all in the free plugin. You’ll see Stripe gifts in your Donations list. PayPal and Venmo send donors to those sites, so you’ll see those gifts in your PayPal or Venmo account. Recording PayPal gifts, recurring donations, and membership dues auto-billing come with Nonprofit Manager Pro.

Can I send email newsletters?

Yes. You write newsletters in the Gutenberg editor, reuse templates, headers, and footers, and see who opened and clicked. You can send a newsletter now or pick a time to send it later. Every newsletter carries a one-click unsubscribe link and a CAN-SPAM footer.

Which email service should I use?

We recommend Amazon SES. It costs $0.10 per 1,000 emails, and you can connect it in Nonprofit Manager Pro with an IAM access key or with SES SMTP credentials. If your host blocks ports 587 and 465, as DigitalOcean does, use SES port 2587. Your From address goes on Nonprofit Manager’s own email only, so WordPress notices and other plugins keep their own unless you turn on “Send all site email from this address.”

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Nonprofit Manager works with any properly coded WordPress theme, and its forms and shortcodes pick up your theme’s styling automatically.

Can I move my events from The Events Calendar?

Yes. Go to Events > Import from TEC. You can import your events, review each one, and then switch over. Anyone who follows an old event URL lands on the new event page.

Can I show past newsletters on my site?

Yes. Open a sent newsletter, tick “Show in the public archive” in the sidebar, and click Update. Then add the Newsletters block or [npmp_newsletters] to any page. You can set limit, order="asc", layout="grid" or "cards", topic, date="no", excerpt="no", and pagination="no", and with Pro, group="computing" lists only that group’s newsletters. You decide which newsletters go public, and we leave the box unticked on every newsletter, old and new. On the public copy, we fill name tags with their defaults and leave out unsubscribe links and tracking. Search engines skip the page unless you turn on indexing under Newsletter Settings.

Can I print my calendar?

Yes. Calendars and event lists have a Print or save as PDF button. You can turn it off for the whole site in the calendar settings, or for one calendar with print="no" on the shortcode.

Can I convert existing posts into events?

Yes. Use the “Convert to Event” action on any post or page. It carries your content over and lets you set the date, time, and location.

How do I import my existing email list?

Go to Membership > Import and choose CSV, XLSX, Google Sheets, Mailchimp, or Constant Contact. The importer detects your columns for you. The free plugin imports up to 100 supporters in total, and Pro removes the cap.

Where can I get support?

Ask in the WordPress.org support forums and we’ll help. Pro includes email support at support@nonprofitmanager.app, with priority replies on the Multi-Site and Developer plans.

  • Put members in one or more groups, each with its own newsletters, events, calendar, and signup form*

Donations

  • Accept one-time donations through PayPal, Venmo, and Stripe. Stripe gifts land in your Donations list, and PayPal and Venmo gifts show up in those accounts
  • Drop a donation form on any page as a block or shortcode, with a thank-you message on the page
  • Take gifts in US, Canadian, Australian, or New Zealand dollars, pounds, euros, yen, and 9 more currencies (Venmo is US dollars only)
  • Recurring donations*
  • Membership dues auto-billing*
  • Donor thank-you emails with the gift amount and date*
  • PayPal gifts recorded in your Donations list through PayPal Smart Buttons, with a server-side check of every capture*

Newsletters and email

  • Write newsletters in the editor you already know (Gutenberg), with reusable templates, headers, and footers
  • See who opens and clicks, tracked in dedicated tables that won’t bloat your database
  • Send yourself a test first, let rate limiting pace large sends, and stay CAN-SPAM compliant
  • One-click unsubscribe with RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers, which Gmail and Yahoo now expect
  • Tell subscribers about new posts and events instantly or in an automatic weekly digest, and let them pick their own preferences
  • Schedule one email for each event, such as a reminder the day before, and send any newsletter later from the Scheduled Emails screen
  • List past newsletters on any page with the Newsletters block or [npmp_newsletters]. You pick which ones go public
  • Past newsletters for one group on that group’s page, with [npmp_newsletters group="computing"]*
  • As many scheduled emails as you want for the whole organization, each group, and each event*
  • Email automation workflows: welcome emails, donation receipts, and expiry reminders*
  • Send through Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark, Brevo, or any SMTP server*

Events

  • Event calendar with Month, Week, and List views, plus Calendar and Events blocks for any page, with list, grid, cards, and mosaic layouts
  • iCal feed, quick-add from the dashboard, and one-click convert of any post or page into an event
  • A Print or save as PDF button on calendars and event lists, with a setting to turn it off
  • Move your events over from The Events Calendar, review each one, and keep redirects from the old event URLs
  • Print or save as PDF any admin list or report*

Sharing and outreach

  • Auto-share new posts and events to Facebook and X, with {title}, {url}, and {excerpt} placeholders
  • Auto-share to Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, and Nextdoor*
  • Add share buttons and a contact form to any page, as blocks or shortcodes

External Services

Nonprofit Manager talks to outside services only where a feature needs it. Nothing below runs unless you turn that feature on or enter your own credentials.

Product update emails (optional, off by default)

If you tick the product update box in the setup wizard, your email address and display name are sent once to our newsletter system at news.nonprofitmanager.app to start a double opt-in signup. You then get one confirmation email, and nothing else is sent unless you click it. Leave the box unticked and no request is made. Data sent: your email address and display name, at that one moment. Service: Listmonk, self-hosted by Rosenberg Digital LLC. Privacy policy: https://nonprofitmanager.app/privacy-policy/

Nonprofit Manager Pro licensing (only with Pro installed)

The free plugin on its own does not contact our servers. If you also install Nonprofit Manager Pro, Pro checks your license and looks for updates at nonprofitmanager.app, sending your license key, your site URL, and the installed version. Terms: https://nonprofitmanager.app/terms-of-service/ Privacy policy: https://nonprofitmanager.app/privacy-policy/

Payment processors (only when you enable one)

Donations are sent to the processor you configure with your own account credentials. Stripe (api.stripe.com), PayPal (paypal.com), and Venmo (venmo.com) receive donation amounts and the donor details you collect. Stripe: https://stripe.com/legal and https://stripe.com/privacy PayPal and Venmo: https://www.paypal.com/legalhub/useragreement-full and https://www.paypal.com/privacy

Spam protection (only when you enable one)

If you turn on a captcha, form submissions are verified with Cloudflare Turnstile (challenges.cloudflare.com) or Google reCAPTCHA (google.com/recaptcha), using your own site keys. Cloudflare: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ and https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/ Google: https://policies.google.com/terms and https://policies.google.com/privacy

List imports (only when you run one)

Importing from Mailchimp or Constant Contact reads your list using the API key you supply. Mailchimp: https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/ and https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/ Constant Contact: https://www.constantcontact.com/legal/terms and https://www.constantcontact.com/legal/privacy-notice

Social sharing (only when you connect an account)

Auto-sharing posts sends the title, link, and excerpt you configure to the networks you connect, using your own account credentials.

upgrade_notice.2026.11.11: Update before you import a list from MailPoet, Newsletter, Paid Memberships Pro, GiveWP, or Charitable, so none of those contacts gets your Pro welcome email.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.10: Keep the paragraphs in your event text on event lists and the events archive.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.9: Add your newsletter footer to every notification, and list past newsletters on your site.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.8: Find Event Details in the editor sidebar, plus fixes for membership levels, Share Now, and every admin screen.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.7: See a warning before an old donation plugin deletes its own data, and import from Paid Memberships Pro.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.6: Move from MailPoet, The Events Calendar, GiveWP, and other plugins on the new Switch Plugins screen.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.5: Outlook readers now see the WebP and AVIF images in your emails.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.4: Fixes the newsletter signup in the setup wizard.
upgrade_notice.2026.11.3: New signups now get an email with a link to confirm before they join your list. You can turn this off under Membership Settings.
upgrade_notice.2026.10.10: No change to the free plugin. Lockstep with Nonprofit Manager Pro 2026.10.10.
upgrade_notice.2026.10.9: You can now tell Nonprofit Manager what kind of group you run (club, school group, team, faith community or HOA) under General Settings and see words that fit it, like Supporters instead of Donors. We also fixed a rare case where a Stripe gift went unrecorded.
upgrade_notice.2026.10.8: Your From address now goes on Nonprofit Manager's own email only, so WordPress notices and other plugins keep their own. If your mail provider accepts only one sender, turn on "Send all site email from this address" under Email Settings.
upgrade_notice.2026.10.7: Fixes a rare case where Stripe charged a donor but the site didn't record the gift. Recommended for every site that takes Stripe gifts.
upgrade_notice.2026.10.2: Fixes donate buttons that did nothing on block themes such as Twenty Twenty-Five, and adds a currency setting for donations outside the US. Recommended for every site.
upgrade_notice.2026.10.1: Adds a Membership Manager role, so a volunteer can work with members, donations and newsletters without full admin access.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.22: Security fixes for the signup form, Stripe checkout and PayPal verification. Recommended for every site.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.21: Security and reliability fixes. Only editors and administrators can send newsletters, the signup form no longer re-subscribes people who opted out, and Stripe and PayPal gifts that were missed before are now recorded.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.20: Constant Contact imports now bring in your contacts, with opt-outs carried over. SparkPost is no longer offered as an email service.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.19: Stripe card payments are now part of the free version for one-time gifts. Monthly giving stays in Pro.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.18: No change to the free plugin. Lockstep with Nonprofit Manager Pro 2026.09.18.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.17: The optional "Powered by" link is now offered once after your first donation instead of in the setup wizard. Nothing changes unless you tick the box. Lockstep with Nonprofit Manager Pro 2026.09.17.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.16: No change to the free plugin. If you also run Nonprofit Manager Pro, updating Pro to 2026.09.16 turns on automatic updates for both plugins, once, so each release installs on both together. Switch them off in Plugins any time and they stay off.
upgrade_notice.2026.09.2: Small display fix in a member's donation history. Worth taking if you also run Nonprofit Manager Pro, which fixes a Monthly Recurring Revenue total that read too high for annual subscriptions.
upgrade_notice.2026.08.4: Adds an admin warning when PayPal donations are being accepted without a PayPal API secret saved, since donations cannot be verified against PayPal in that state.
upgrade_notice.2026.08.3: Recommended update. Fixes a broken X/Twitter share, shifted calendar event times, an ignored default-membership-level setting, a one-cent undercharge on some donation amounts, and an annual recurring total that read low. Also closes a gap that let a logged-out visitor log a fake donation. Raises the minimum PHP version to 8.1, so sites on PHP 8.0 or older will not be offered this update until they upgrade.
upgrade_notice.2026.08.2: Maintenance release keeping the free plugin in lockstep with Pro 2026.08.2. No functional changes to the free plugin.
upgrade_notice.2026.08.1: Maintenance update. The plugin's home moved to nonprofitmanager.app and all links now point there. Old links redirect, so existing installs keep working.
upgrade_notice.2026.07.4: Recommended update. Fixes "Force From Address" incorrectly rewriting mail from other plugins, batches the weekly digest so large lists can't stall it, cuts memory use on large CSV/XLSX imports, and moves newsletter tracking off wp_posts onto dedicated tables.
upgrade_notice.2026.07.3: Recommended update. Fixes recurring Stripe donations (previously charged once instead of on a schedule), adds donor confirmation messages and emails, stops abandoned checkouts from being logged as donations, and closes a few security and performance gaps.
upgrade_notice.2026.07.2: Adds five editor blocks: email signup, unsubscribe, donation form, social share, and contact form. Each is also a shortcode. Includes new visitor social-share buttons and a contact form.
upgrade_notice.2026.07.1: Maintenance update: a PHP 8.1 fix, an optional attribution link (off by default), and a dismissible review reminder.
upgrade_notice.2.1.0: Adds one-click unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe headers for better deliverability, default form styles, a setup health check, and a CAN-SPAM postal address setting. Fixes unsubscribe-link resolution and the Sentry version tag.
upgrade_notice.2.0.0: Major update: Stripe payments for free users, social sharing, subscriber preferences, convert-to-event, and newsletter click tracking. Pro adds license system, recurring donations, custom fields, automation, segmentation, and import tools.
upgrade_notice.1.1.3: Feature update with improved UI, membership summary tables, and better navigation. Recommended for all users.
